pages.title: Regular Shedding
pages.text: Chickens (both $(bold)roosters and hens$()) regularly shed feathers. About once per in-game day (plus a random 1~3 hours), they drop $(bold)1-2 feathers$() each time.$(br2)Chicks do not shed until they grow up - feathers start dropping once they become adults.

pages.title: Uses
pages.text: Feathers are a key material for crafting arrows, firework stars and more - a great byproduct of raising chickens.$(br2)Dropped feathers appear at the chicken's feet just like eggs; simply pick them up.

pages.title: Jade Display
pages.text: With Jade installed, looking at an adult chicken shows a $(bold)next feather drop$() countdown (minutes/seconds remaining), so you can plan your harvest time.
